understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked '+' in each level and continue until the game is won, while avoiding spike tiles that end an attempt.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT shift the player horizontally, after which gravity automatically carries the player until landing, hitting a hazard, or reaching the goal. Gravity direction determines whether the player falls toward smaller or larger y-values. CLICK with a target position removes clickable breakable tiles without moving the player or advancing the rising-platform timer, allowing blocked paths to open. Spike tiles are fatal; each level provides two attempts and a turn limit. UNDO reverts the previous action and can recover from a mistaken click or move. Landing previews and corridor scans indicate safe destinations and passage columns to prioritize.
